primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired binary analysis on the preregistered 500 adversarial tasks (paired episodes 1..500). For each task, extract final_guarded_outcome and baseline_outcome from execution/scoring/task-<id>-guarded.json and execution/scoring/task-<id>-baseline.json (result schema paired_binary_episode_v1). Compute absolute risk difference (guarded minus baseline) and report point estimate. Compute 95% bootstrap percentile CI using 10,000 bootstrap resamples over the 500 paired units (artifact: execution/raw_results.jsonl). Perform two-sided McNemar test (α=0.05) on the paired binary outcomes (contingency from scoring artifacts). Primary denominator: 500 complete, non-flagged paired episodes as defined in preregistration and execution_manifest; exclude runs flagged by preregistered contamination rules from the primary analysis.
secondary_analyses: Logistic regression (exploratory/secondary) predicting final_guarded_outcome with predictors: baseline_outcome, topology_cluster (predefined five clusters from task_manifest), and syntactic_feature_counts extracted from transformation_manifest; report odds ratios and 95% Wald CIs (artifacts: execution/transformation_manifest.json, execution/task_manifest.jsonl, execution/scoring/*.json).

Pre-specified topology-strata confirmatory subgroup analyses: compute paired absolute risk difference within each of the five topology clusters (Cisco-like, Juniper-like, Arista-like, Mixed, Minimal). Apply Holm–Bonferroni adjustment to p-values for these five confirmatory subgroup tests. Report unadjusted estimates and adjusted p-values. (Artifacts: execution/task_manifest.jsonl, execution/scoring/*.json).

Descriptive summaries (exploratory): initial unsafe-proposal rate before repair, repair success rate (proportion of initially unsafe proposals becoming safe within the max one repair), distribution of repair iterations and repair latency, and per-vendor summaries (artifacts: execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json).
sensitivity_analyses: Failed-call treatment sensitivity: repeat primary analysis under the preregistered alternate failed-call policy complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat any failed/flagged guarded episode as final_guarded_outcome=0 and include the pair).

Contamination-inclusion sensitivity: include runs previously excluded for contamination flags and (a) impute worst-case for final_guarded_outcome (set to unsafe=1) and (b) report stratified results by flagged vs non-flagged. Use execution/execution_log.jsonl, execution/responses/* hashes, and provider-call artifacts to identify flagged runs.

Replacement-inclusion sensitivity: if preregistration replacements occurred, run primary analysis both (i) on realized 500 non-flagged paired tasks (primary) and (ii) on the pre-replacement enumeration (include replaced task records) to verify robustness (artifacts: execution/task_manifest.jsonl, execution/execution_log.jsonl).
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: 95% bootstrap percentile CIs from 10,000 bootstrap resamples over paired tasks for the absolute risk difference; report McNemar two-sided p-value (α=0.05). Secondary: report logistic regression 95% Wald CIs and p-values; subgroup estimates with Holm–Bonferroni adjusted p-values for the five confirmatory strata. Report exact counts and proportions with binomial CIs for descriptive rates. All uncertainty computations use deterministic RNG seeds recorded in execution artifacts and are reproducible from execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary multiplicity control: single pre-specified confirmatory test = paired McNemar on the 500 adversarial tasks (no adjustment). Pre-specified confirmatory subgroup family: five topology clusters — adjust p-values across these five tests using Holm–Bonferroni. All other secondary and exploratory comparisons reported with unadjusted CIs and labeled as exploratory. Full list of all tested comparisons reported in analysis outputs (artifact: analysis log derived from execution/execution_log.jsonl).
contamination_analysis: Detect contamination per preregistration using: (1) Batfish-coverage verification artifacts and injected-fault checks from transformation_manifest and execution/raw_results.jsonl; (2) per-run prompt/output hashing (execution/responses/* hashes) to flag identical outputs across distinct seeds; (3) model-id strings and provider call records (execution/provider_calls/task-*.json) to detect model-id drift; (4) Batfish verdict absence or Batfish crash recorded in execution/execution_log.jsonl. Treatment: exclude flagged runs from primary confirmatory analysis (documenting flags and counts). Provide sensitivity analyses that (a) include flagged runs with worst-case imputation, and (b) stratify results by flagged vs non-flagged. All flags, detection artifacts, and mitigation steps are logged and referenced to execution artifact paths and hashes in the execution_manifest.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Paired episode result table (one row per task_id 1..500): seed, topology_cluster, baseline_outcome, final_guarded_outcome, repair_attempted(boolean), repair_iterations, batfish_verdicts, model_id_strings, timestamps, hashes. Source: execution/scoring/task-*.json, execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/task_manifest.jsonl (artifact hashes recorded in execution_manifest).
Table 2 — Primary contingency table for McNemar (counts of discordant pairs: baseline=0/guarded=1, baseline=1/guarded=0) with McNemar statistic and two-sided p-value. Source: derived from Table 1.

Table 3 — Subgroup summary by topology cluster (n, baseline unsafe rate, guarded unsafe rate, paired absolute risk difference, 95% bootstrap CI, Holm–Bonferroni adjusted p-value). Source: execution/task_manifest.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.

Table 4 — Repair outcomes: initial unsafe-proposal rate, repair success rate, distribution of repair iterations (counts and percentiles), per-vendor breakdown. Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.

Table 5 — Contamination and failure log: counts and task_ids for flagged runs (identical-output flags, missing Batfish verdicts, model-id drift), retry/replacement actions and hashes. Source: execution/execution_log.jsonl, execution/provider_calls/*.json, execution/responses/* hashes (artifact paths in execution_manifest).
figure_specifications: Figure 1 — Primary effect: bar (or point) plot of absolute risk difference (guarded minus baseline) with 95% bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples) for the overall sample (n=500). Data source: Table 1 (execution/scoring/*.json).
Figure 2 — McNemar discordant-pair mosaic or contingency visualization showing the four-cell paired table and annotation of McNemar p-value. Source: contingency derived from execution/scoring/*.json.
Figure 3 — Subgroup forest plot: per-topology absolute risk differences with 95% bootstrap CIs and Holm–Bonferroni adjusted p-values annotated. Source: Table 3.

Figure 4 — Repair-iteration distribution (histogram or ECDF) and boxplot of repair latency; annotated median iterations to acceptance. Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.

Figure 5 — Execution flow and exclusions diagram: counts of planned tasks, completed pairs, exclusions for contamination, replacements, and sensitivity-analysis branches; reference to execution_manifest artifact hashes (execution/execution_log.jsonl).
